question: What was unremarkable about Usain Bolt's 9.58-second 100 m world record in Berlin in 2009?
answer: His start. His reaction to the gun, 0.146 seconds, was the third slowest of the eight finalists. The record was built later: laser measurements put his top speed above 12.3 m/s, about 44 km/h, and he held close to it all the way from 50 m to the line.
move: Find where a winner gained the time before praising the obvious part.
source: Multicomponent velocity analysis of Bolt's record, 2023
